Body.Content:
Administrators can now enable time-zone-independent behavior for the Time Entry Grid so that time entries appear on the same calendar date, regardless of a user's time zone. This helps organizations with globally distributed teams maintain a consistent view of reported time and eliminates issues where entries appear on different dates due to time zone conversions.

The enhancement improves accuracy, simplifies reconciliation and approvals, and ensures users see and manage time entries based on the intended business date rather than their local time zone.

Business Value:

Make it easier for your global teams to stay aligned by showing time entries on the same date for everyone. This prevents unexpected date changes from time zone conversions, so you keep data consistent and avoid confusion.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

More info: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dynamics365/project-operations/time/time-entry-configurations

GA date: July CY2026
